scope: Source-framework-family isolated controlled screenshot probes, not real production sites or independent authored-page corpus. Original upstream HTML/CSS are sanitized for offline rendering; no common content scaffold is added.
word_policy: FROZEN. No editing, overwriting, copying as a new version, or invoking taskbook writers without explicit user request.

word_reference.archive_path: protocol/网页截图的细微变更分类｜实验任务书_v1.1.docx

generation.external_assets: scripts, images/media, external fonts and CSS url() are removed; HTML/CSS source hashes retained
generation.targets: Deterministically selected visible existing text, box and flex elements. No ground-truth region is supplied to the models.
generation.ineligible_policy: Record skip when no valid element or no visible pixels changed. Do not replace after seeing model results.
generation.order: All plans and source-family split frozen before feature/model evaluation.
generation.deduplication: Exact baseline pixel hashes collapse duplicate scroll views; exact after hashes per baseline keep first only.

evaluation.fit: Classification and learned gate fit only source train families; detector thresholds calibrated only development-family negatives. Existing DiffSpot240 used only to design fixed features.
evaluation.confirmation: Open once after all models and thresholds frozen; no adjustment after reveal.
evaluation.limits: Only6 confirmation families; intervals have low group count. Controlled CSS probes and sanitized pages do not establish unseen real-site generalization.
evaluation.negative_controls: Unique baseline screenshot and nuisance only; never repeated once per mutation. Report actual independent baseline count and family count, not a supported5% bound.

plan: Download pinned HTML/CSS/license source bytes and verify Git blob hashes.
Sanitize network-dependent content, render baseline and three-level13 CSS modifications, audit changed pixels and deterministic restoration.
Fit frozen methods only on source train families; calibrate on source development families.
Seal model/config hashes before one confirmation evaluation.
Record failures and limits, publish only scripts/configuration/filtered results; Word and raw media remain local.
